sources.entry: TinyPNG4Mac - Open-source tool to compress images. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/kyleduo/TinyPNG4Mac)

summary.one_liner: A macOS desktop app that compresses images through the TinyPNG API, so you can shrink files without opening a browser.
summary.what_it_does: The app is a third-party macOS client for the TinyPNG image compression service. You add an API key in its Settings window, then drag in images or folders containing images to compress them. A Finder right-click action ("Services -> Compress with Tiny Image") is also available for image files and folders. The release notes describe format conversion to PNG, JPEG, AVIF or WEBP, either to a chosen format or automatically to the smallest supported one. The app also keeps a cache of the number of images compressed. The README is short and does not describe internal architecture.
use_cases: Compress PNG or JPEG images without using a browser
Batch shrink a folder of images by dragging it into a window
Convert images to WEBP or AVIF from macOS
Reduce image file sizes from Finder right-click menu
Automatically pick the smallest format for an image
how_to_run: Register for a TinyPNG API key at the link given in the README
Download the app from the Release Page
Open the Settings window and paste your API key
Drag images or directories into the app window
Or right-click image files or folders in Finder and choose Services -> Compress with Tiny Image
notable: Finder Services integration for right-click compression
Format conversion to PNG, JPEG, AVIF or WEBP, including automatic smallest-format selection
Drag-and-drop support for images and directories
Renamed from TinyPNG4Mac to Image Image, per the README
caveats: Requires a TinyPNG API key and a registration step
Version 2.0.0 and later need macOS 13 Ventura or newer; older systems must use the previous version
You may need to allow the app under System Settings -> Security & privacy if macOS blocks it
